evals.name: small-go-image
evals.prompt: Write a multi-stage Dockerfile for a Go API service producing a minimal, secure production image.
evals.expected_output: Multi-stage build with build stage compiling static binary and scratch/distroless runtime stage.
assertions: Uses multi-stage Dockerfile with dedicated builder image.
Compiles static binary with CGO_ENABLED=0 and -ldflags='-w -s'.
Runtime image is based on scratch or gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12.

evals.name: build-cache-optimization
evals.prompt: Optimize Dockerfile layers so dependency downloads are cached across source code edits.
evals.expected_output: Copying go.mod and go.sum before source files and running go mod download in a separate layer.
assertions: Copies go.mod and go.sum prior to copying application source tree.
Runs go mod download in an isolated cacheable layer.
Source code copy layer is placed after dependency caching.

evals.name: non-root-security
evals.prompt: Configure container security in Dockerfile to ensure the Go process does not run as root.
evals.expected_output: Creates unprivileged user/group and specifies USER directive, copying ca-certificates.
assertions: Creates an unprivileged non-root user (e.g. nonroot:nonroot).
Declares USER nonroot in the runtime stage.
Copies /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt to allow outgoing HTTPS calls.
